title: Sharing Rules list shows the recipient's and object's labels, not api names
body:
## Source

Walked on objectui main `8415d9f11`, `/apps/com.objectstack.setup/sys_sharing_rule` (11 rows from HotCRM): Object `crm_account`, Recipient Type `position`, Recipient `sales_manager` / `eu_sales_team` / `escalated_from`, Access Level `edit`. The same rule in Studio's Access pillar reads "Account", "Sales Manager".

## Target

1. Object column: the object's icon and label (api name in the tooltip).
2. Recipient: the position / team / user label resolved through the same lookup the Access pillar uses; the type as a small chip before it ("Position · Sales Manager", "Field · Escalated from").
3. Access level as a chip (Read / Edit) with the same tokens the permission matrix uses.

## File surface

The `sys_sharing_rule` list view definition the console ships (or, if the columns come from the platform's view, objectstack-ai/objectstack's platform-objects view — the card says so and files it there), the cell renderers in `packages/plugin-grid` / `plugin-list` for metadata references, tests beside.

## Acceptance

1. Tests: a rule with recipient `sales_manager` renders "Sales Manager".
2. Screenshot at 1280 px.
3. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell test` green.

## Constraints

- The stored values do not change; display only.

## Evidence

No screenshot; the measurements above and the page URLs are the evidence.

<sub>Filed by the epic PM session `session_cdb7a717-def7-4e71-9988-f089fbaa18ff` from the 2026-10-16 second review pass: objectui main `8415d9f11`, HotCRM `63db83e2`, the vite console on :5180 against `objectstack serve --dev` on :4001, the Studio pillars and all 43 Setup pages walked in the maintainer's browser pane at 1024 × 768 (en) with a 1280 × 900 re-check (zh). The maintainer asked for every finding to be filed, verbatim: 「全部立卡」.</sub>
